name: stocksense
description: StockSense: modular inventory management (Odoo hackathon problem statement)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('server/.env')){fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env');console.log('Created server/.env from .env.example')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
